evals.name: incremental-bug-sync-deep-paging
evals.prompt: 我们公司用 TAPD 企业版，管理员给了一个 API 账号和口令。帮我写个 Python 脚本，每小时跑一次，把某个项目（workspace_id 已知）里过去一小时内修改过的缺陷同步到本地 SQLite（标题、状态、严重程度、处理人、最后修改时间）。第一次运行要全量导入，这个项目历史缺陷大约 5 万条。
evals.expected_output: 脚本用 API 账号做 HTTP Basic 调 https://api.tapd.cn/bugs，workspace_id 放 query；增量用 modified=>时间 或 起~止 这种写在值里的时间查询；字段用 title / current_owner / severity / status / modified；limit 不超过 200；全量导入不靠超过 20000 深度的 page 翻页，而是游标或时间窗切片；从 row['Bug'] 解包；判 HTTP 200 且 status==1；ID 存字符串；429/500/502 退避重试。
expectations: Authenticates with HTTP Basic using the API account and password read from environment variables (requests auth=(user, password) or an 'Authorization: Basic' header), not a Bearer token and not a personal login email/password
Calls GET https://api.tapd.cn/bugs over https with workspace_id as a query parameter

Filters the incremental window with TAPD's value-embedded time syntax on the modified field, e.g. modified=>YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS or modified=start~end, rather than invented parameters such as modified_after, updated_since, start_time or since
Uses bug field names title, current_owner, severity, status and modified (not name, owner, assignee, updated_at)
Requests at most 200 rows per page (limit <= 200)

For the ~50k full import it does not rely on page*limit going beyond 20000: it uses cursor paging (cursor = last id of previous page, id ordering, serial requests) or splits the import into time windows that each stay under 20000 rows
Unwraps each list item from its 'Bug' wrapper object (row['Bug']) instead of reading fields directly from data[i]
Treats a response as successful only when HTTP status is 200 and body status == 1, surfacing body info otherwise
[no-cred probe 2026-09-11, undocumented] Checks that data is a list before iterating (a misspelled path returns HTTP 200, status 1 and a 'Hello world from TAPD API' string)
Stores bug ids as strings and backs off / retries on HTTP 429, 500 or 502

evals.name: create-story-then-log-time
evals.prompt: 用 Python 调 TAPD API（凭证是 API 账号）：在项目里新建一条高优先级需求「支付回调超时重试」，处理人 zhangsan，放进名为「2026-W38」的迭代；然后给这条需求记一笔工时：今天、zhangsan、3 小时。如果今天 zhangsan 已经在这条需求上记过工时，就在原来的基础上再加 3 小时。
evals.expected_output: 先 GET /iterations 按名字查迭代 ID 并精确过滤；POST /stories 带 workspace_id、name、priority_label、owner、iteration_id 创建需求并从 data['Story']['id'] 取字符串 ID；GET /timesheets 按 entity_type=story、entity_id、owner、spentdate=今天 查已有记录；有则 POST /timesheets 带 id、timespent=旧值+3 覆盖更新，无则 POST /timesheets 新建（entity_type、entity_id、timespent、spentdate、owner、workspace_id）；每步判 status==1。
expectations: Resolves the iteration id with GET https://api.tapd.cn/iterations?workspace_id=...&name=2026-W38 and filters for an exact name match (the name filter is fuzzy), instead of passing the iteration name as iteration_id
Creates the story with POST https://api.tapd.cn/stories including workspace_id and name (not title), sent form-encoded, or as JSON with Content-Type: application/json
Sets priority through priority_label (e.g. High) rather than the legacy numeric priority mapping or a guessed priority=high
Sets owner to the TAPD nickname (zhangsan or zhangsan;) and iteration_id to the resolved iteration id
Reads the new story id from data['Story']['id'] (a single wrapped object, not a list) and keeps it as a string
Before creating a timesheet, queries GET /timesheets with workspace_id, entity_type=story, entity_id, owner and spentdate=today, because one entity/date/owner may only have a single timesheet record

When a record exists, updates it with POST /timesheets carrying id and timespent = old value + 3 (update overwrites, it does not add); otherwise creates one with POST /timesheets carrying entity_type, entity_id, timespent, spentdate in YYYY-MM-DD, owner and workspace_id
Uses POST for updates (no PUT or PATCH) and checks body status == 1 after every call

evals.name: webhook-bug-status-receiver
evals.prompt: 我们在 TAPD 开放平台的应用里配置了「事件订阅」，订阅了缺陷的变更事件，内容类型还没最终定（json 和 form 都可能），也填了 secret。用 Flask 写接收服务：缺陷状态变了就打印「缺陷标题：旧状态(中文) -> 新状态(中文)」，并且要确认请求确实来自 TAPD。
evals.expected_output: Flask 接口同时解析 JSON 和 form；用 body 里的 secret 字段与配置值做常量时间比较并拒绝空值，不去算不存在的签名头；按 bug::status_change 或 change_fields 含 status 的 bug::update 判断状态变化；旧状态取 old_status，新状态与标题用 GET /bugs?workspace_id=&id= 拉最新；状态中英文用 /workflows/status_map?system=bug 转换；尽快回 200 并按 event_id 去重；id 当字符串。
expectations: Accepts both application/json and application/x-www-form-urlencoded payloads (form is the documented default for the legacy webhook channel and one of the two content types in app event subscriptions)

Verifies origin by comparing the 'secret' field in the payload body with the configured secret, ideally with a constant-time comparison, and rejects an empty secret; it does not invent an HMAC signature or signature header, which the docs do not define
Detects a status change via event 'bug::status_change' and/or 'bug::update' whose change_fields contains 'status'
Takes the previous status from old_status and fetches the current title and status with GET https://api.tapd.cn/bugs?workspace_id=...&id=..., because update payloads carry only old_* values
Maps English status keys to Chinese names via GET /workflows/status_map?system=bug&workspace_id=... (or /bugs/get_fields_info) instead of a hardcoded dictionary
Returns HTTP 200 promptly and de-duplicates deliveries by event_id
Treats id and event_id as strings (19-digit ids)
